newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Joyce opens biggest store in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Joyce opens biggest store in Hong Kong.

text.p: Upmarket retailer Joyce Boutique Holdings Ltd opened its biggest store in Hong Kong on Wednesday, a HK$50 million, 47,000 sq ft arcade in the crowded shopping district of Tsimshatsui.

Company officials said the opening of the flagship store, based on the tip of the Kowloon peninsula showed confidence in Hong Kong's retailing future after the colony's handover to China in mid-1997 and said the store would be a "magnet" for luxury shopping in the area.

"While we are committed to growing our business in other major regional markets, Hong Kong will continue to be central to our own operation," managing director Roberto Dominici said in a prepared statement.
The company has specialty stores, boutiques and restaurants throughout Asia including South Korea, Thailand and Taiwan.

Joyce reported profit attributable to shareholders of HK$81.1 million for the year ended March 31, 1996, an increase of 7.8 percent over the previous year. Earnings per share rose one percent to 29.2 cents.
